description: For a home postcode, list nearby state schools with the straight-line distance from the postcode centre, the last distance offered in each of the last three years (council allocation figures) and a reading of the chances: Likely at 80% of the last distance or less, Possible up to 110%, Stretch beyond it. Faith and selective schools are capped at Possible because other rules decide places.

postcode.description: A full UK postcode (e.g. "KT10 8PQ") or an outcode (e.g. "KT10").

radius_km.description: Search radius. Default 2 km for primary, 5 km for secondary.

name: check_catchment_chances
title: Catchment chances from a postcode
